scope: mHC (hyperconnection mix) stage fp64 qualification: rounding level, Metal deltas and 1-ULP input amplification. Independent CPU reference parameterized comptime (math.zig MixOf/denseOf/mixesOf/splitOf/inverseOf/collapseOf/expandOf, f32 source-contract path bit-identical, f64 ideal path); harness zig/tests/deepseek_v41_reference/operator_hc_fp64.zig; fixtures hc_attention_rms.json and hc_fp64_rows.json (retained inputs only).
nrms_definition: sqrt(sum(delta^2)/sum(ref^2)) in f64; ULP = |delta| / fp32 spacing at the fp64 reference value.
inputs: token1_ffn (retained token-1 FFN stream and branch, real hc_ffn scale/base)
split_args (16 retained unary arguments incl. 1.4393715858459473, controlling post argument, integer exp sweep -32..32, plus sigmoid/softmax spans)

metal_vs_fp64.verdict: every sub-stage sits at the fp32 source-contract rounding level; Metal exceeds the fp32 reference by at most ~1 ULP at the documented Metal exp boundary

amplification_1ulp_input.method: perturb one bf16 stream cell (or branch cell) by 1 ULP, propagate the ideal fp64 stage, output NRMS growth = sqrt(sum(dy^2)/sum(y^2)) / (|dx|/sqrt(sum(x^2))); 256 sampled cells per row; 8 teacher positions plus the token-1 FFN row
amplification_1ulp_input.bf16_rows_changed_fraction: 224-250 of 256 perturbations change at least one of 20480 output cells

gate_reading: A single-ULP input difference is attenuated by the mix in exact arithmetic (gain < 1) and appears as 1-bf16-ULP flips on about 0.06 percent of output cells; the stage's own rounding-level output NRMS is 0 to 2.5e-5. Hyperconnection mixing therefore cannot turn fp32 ULP noise into the observed 4.096 percent whole-model NRMS; a specific operator-level difference elsewhere (sparse/compressed attention candidates) remains the plausible cause.
kernel_changes: none required; no tolerance relaxed, no source coefficient injected
receipts: gitignored receipts/ (mhc-fp64-run.log, mhc-fp64-parsed.json, build-summary.log); commit contains code, fixture and this summary
